llamacpp._note: gguf_path + n_gpu_layers set during T5.5 prep once the GGUF is downloaded; n_gpu_layers tuned to what fits the 12 GB card.

cold_flush._note: Sysinternals RAMMap '-Et' empties the Windows Standby List (cached file pages); '-accepteula' makes it non-interactive. Needs Administrator. No freed-MB threshold: standby counts toward 'available' on Windows so the delta is ~0 even on a real flush (ADR 0001) — cold-ness is proven by the cold/warm timing delta.
